text:
maria: Quick FYI — I found two related doc breakages after yesterday's SDK push:
- examples still use `max_tokens` (should be `max_output_tokens`)
- function-calling examples show the old `function_call` shape; runtime now emits `tool_calls` shape for tool integrations

alex: thanks — can you point me to 1–2 files where this shows up? I can open PRs for node + go snippets today :+1:

maria: node/snippets/generate.md and go/snippets/call_function.md are the main ones. Also a couple of README code blocks under guides/migrations/v1-to-v2.md

alex: OK opening PRs now — draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/457 (node) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/458 (go). I'll add before/after snippets and a short note about backward compatibility.

cheng: note for the migration blurb: hosted API will still accept `max_tokens` for a short grace period but Dedicated/Private might already enforce `max_output_tokens`. We should call that out explicitly so customers on Dedicated don't get surprised.

sam: good catch. Can we add a tiny checklist to the migration guide: search/replace `max_tokens` -> `max_output_tokens`, update function-calling examples, run smoke tests for streaming/gRPC snippets, and verify embed dims if any model aliases changed?

ajay: I can take Ruby and Python snippets. I'll grep the repo and batch up changes. Which cutoff date should we put in the deprecation note?

maria: let's say: "Deprecated: support for `max_tokens` will be removed on 2026-06-15; we recommend updating by 2026-05-15." (we'll sync with PMs before publishing)

alex: PRs updated with docs fixes and example diffs. Node snippet replacement example (inline):

```js
// OLD
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', prompt, max_tokens: 256 })

// NEW
const resp = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-3', prompt, max_output_tokens: 256 })
```

alex: and function-calling shape sample (old vs new):

```jsonc
// OLD (simplified)
{
  "function_call": { "name": "get_weather", "arguments": "{ \"q\": \"sf\" }" }
}

// NEW (tool_calls)
{
  "tool_calls": [
    { "tool": "get_weather", "args": { "q": "sf" }, "metadata": { "source": "sdk" } }
  ]
}
```

cheng: also add a short runtime note under the migration guide: "If you rely on gateway behavior for tool payloads, test end-to-end — behavior differs slightly for streaming vs non-streaming routes."

sam: I'll draft the deprecation banner copy and PR description: short blurb, timeline, who is impacted (Hosted: soft, Dedicated/Private: immediate), migration steps, links to SDK PRs and smoke tests.

ajay: grep + sed quick commands I used to gather files (feel free to reuse):

```
git grep -n "max_tokens" docs || true
sed -n '1,240p' docs/snippets/node/generate.md | sed -n '1,120p'
```

maria: thanks everyone. Once PRs are merged we'll add a short redirect note and trigger a docs site rebuild. @docs-bot can you post build link when done? :pray:

docs-bot: PRs 457, 458, 459 (py), 460 (rb) submitted. CI: docs lint passed, snippet smoke tests queued.

deploy-bot: docs site rebuild queued — https://deploys.redwood-inference.com/builds/8332 (watch for broken anchors after the rename)

alex: merged node + go PRs, added automated codemod note to help users. Leaving the inline examples updated and added a small migration snippet for sed-based replacement.

ajay: opened py + rb PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459 and /460.

sam: I'll schedule the deprecation announcement for next Tuesday and ping infra for a dedicated support window.

maria: perfect — I'll follow up with a quick checklist to the release thread and add a short sample test that checks `max_output_tokens` in our smoke harness.

(THREAD END)
